items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: And we had, in the trombones we had Tommy Shelvin who went to California

ctx.x: Edmund Hogan, that's his brother. And Warren Skinner, he's a, I don't have a picture of that band here. I had a picture, I don't know what happened to it. Warren Skinner's a physical ed teacher, he played baritone sax. And Lloyd Bellamy, he's a musician around town, I believe he stopped playing, he played saxophone. He lived right next to the rhythm club. He was in the rhythm club, or Jackson. He was in Jackson. His family owned that house, they're still on it, if I'm not mistaken. And we had, in the trombones we…
Did he play with Tommy originally? Probably did, yeah.
